title: Barcelona segway
text: The tour guide was friendly and knowledgeable. It was a good trip and good value for money. We saw alot of the city., that we hadn't seen before.
author: Pauline_S

title: Excellent tour
text: Excellent tour.  Bilal was awesome in how he taught us how to use the Segway… and then the perfect tour around Barcelona.  He took pictures of us..showed us unique aspects of the city and truly went above and beyond!  Thank you Bilal- we will recommend you highly!
author: Michelle_K

title: Perfect for first timer
text:
“This was such a fun way to explore the city! The Segways were easy to use, and our guide  Natasha made the whole experience unforgettable. Highly recommend this tour for anyone looking for a unique adventure!”

“The perfect balance of fun and learning! Natasha was hilarious and shared so much interesting history along the way. I’d do this again in a heartbeat.”
author: 170shehzadn

title: Outstanding
text: Natasha was an excellent tour guide and gave us enough time at different locations! She have detailed explanations and was very patient with us even though we were late!! Definitely recommend in Barcelona!
author: Vinita_M

title: Highly reccomend
text: A great way to see the city and learn more about Barcelona! Our guide was super lovely and kept us safe and made sure we felt comfortable throughout
author: Sim C

title: Recommended!
text: The reservation had not come through well, but after a phone call everything was done to make it happen. We had a nice guide and we enjoyed the tour.
author: Krista W

title: A lot of fun!
text: Natasha was really informative and spoke good English, she made sure we were both okay with the Segways and we had a lot of fun!
author: georgie_19941

title: Amazing tour
text:
I went to this tour with my entire family. A teenager boy  and a 11 years old boy. Natasha took the time to teach us how to ride the Segway till we feel comfortable. We did a two hour tour. It was fun for all family. We went around Barceloneta, Puerto Olímpico and the Park. She showed us around there and explained all the fact. I will recommend this tour to everybody. 
Natasha was and excellent guide.
author: Natalia_S

title: A great way to tour the city
text: My girlfriend and I had a great time on the segway tour. Our guide Natasha was very welcoming and was clearly knowledgable about the city and segways. We started by having a practice on the segways before visiting various parts of the city, including Columbus’ Column, the beach, Olympic Park, and Ciutadella Park. I would highly recommend this to anyone
author: 998shaunn

title: Fantastic experience great tour guide
text: The tour was great and Natasha was fantastic and very knowledgeable. I would highly recommend if you are in Barcelona
author: Willrg95
